		Dataset Summary
	

ColBERT Humor contains 200,000 labeled short texts, equally distributed between humorous and non-humorous content. The dataset was created to overcome the limitations of prior humor detection datasets, which were characterized by inconsistencies in text length, word count, and formality, making them easy to predict with simple models without truly understanding the nuances of humor.
